cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Absolutely, I'll help move your boxes downstairs. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Carry that box yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. I'll hire a mover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll carry them if you hold the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means preventing movement. I'll wedge the door open and supervise from this chair.
